page.title_en: ADS42JB49 14-Bit 250-MSPS Dual-Channel ADC with JESD204B Interface
page.title_zh: ADS42JB49 14位250 MSPS双通道ADC，支持JESD204B接口
page.meta_description_en: ADS42JB49 is a dual-channel 14-bit 250-MSPS ADC with JESD204B interface, featuring 2 VPP/2.5 VPP input, 85 fS rms aperture jitter, 100 dB channel isolation, and 850 mW/Ch power dissipation. Ideal for communication and radar systems.
page.meta_description_zh: ADS42JB49是双通道14位250 MSPS ADC，支持JESD204B接口，具备2 VPP/2.5 VPP输入、85 fS均方根孔径抖动、100 dB通道隔离和850 mW/通道功耗，适用于通信和雷达系统。
